scripts.build: wrangler types -c wrangler.jsonc && astro check && astro build
scripts.preview: wrangler types -c wrangler.jsonc && astro build && astro preview
scripts.typecheck: wrangler types -c wrangler.jsonc && astro sync && astro check
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.deploy:preprod: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=preprod npm run build && wrangler deploy
scripts.preview:cloudflare: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=preprod npm run build && node scripts/preview-upload.mjs
